summary_1line: Narada’s pride leads to humiliation and a curse on Vishnu, followed by repentance and a cosmological discourse on Shiva, Shakti, and the origins of Vishnu and Brahma.

image_candidates.scene_text: Princess Srimati passes by Narada in the royal court and garlands the disguised Prince Vishnu while the sage sits proudly, unaware of the monkey face he bears.
Narada stares into a mirror in shock as he sees a monkey’s face attached to Vishnu’s divine body after the failed svayamvara.
Shiva and Shakti gaze at each other in radiant stillness as a sapphire-blue four‑armed child, Vishnu, manifests before them in a burst of light.
